replies.author: Vobaseball12
replies.body:
Looks: It's very plain, and even though I value gameplay over looks (especially in a tm map) I feel if though there's just no aspect of design here.

Gameplay: From what I see in the pictures it's very big. This is not really fit for a 10v10, which most tournaments are. The path to the wool room is too straight and way too long. I don't really feel like the middle island is actually really needed that much, it just looks like some water. Maybe if you turn it so it goes across the the whole void gap, that'd be better, but IMO I really just don't think it's needed. Of course it will probably be tested and then we'll find out.

If you could please add pictures of what is in the chests, that would be very nice. 

My post may come off a bit rude, and that's not my intention. It's kinda like a teacher grading a writing piece, I'm just giving constructive criticism. Nice work!
